verdict.rationale: New Relic exposes NerdGraph (GraphQL API) for querying metrics, logs, and traces, NRQL for structured queries, and a documented official MCP server (Nov 2025) that lets external AI agents/dev tools query telemetry data using natural language converted to NRQL, directly enabling agent-driven production debugging. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server's reliability and no public OpenAPI spec (llms.txt/openapi.json probes 404, relying on GraphQL/NerdGraph docs instead).
